blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Monocular 3D human pose estimation (HPE) remains challenging due to depth ambiguity, occlusions, and the need for temporal consistency. While multi-view methods provide superior accuracy over monocular approaches, they often require complex setups. We introduce STA-TFM, a transformer-based architecture that combines spatial and temporal information for multi-view pose estimation. The approach leverages DSTformer, a monocular feature extractor, to capture long-range pose dependencies within each view. A fusion transformer then aggregates information across views to produce coherent 3D estimates. To address training data scarcity, we use a data generation pipeline that transforms any existing 3D pose dataset into multi-view setups with controllable parameters. Experiments on various datasets demonstrate that STA-TFM outperforms existing camera-parameter-free multi-view methods. STA-TFM achieves 50.9% and 49.5% reductions in mean per joint position error (MPJPE) and mean per joint velocity error (MPJVE) on the DHP19 dataset. Furthermore, it achieves 6.7% and 7.7% respective reductions on HAA4D, and a 15.2% MPJPE reduction on TotalCapture. STA-TFM handles noisy and missing 2D inputs, supporting potential deployment in healthcare monitoring, athletic assessment, and immersive technologies. Code, training checkpoints, and data are available at https://zenodo.org/records/22832620 .
blocks.zh: 单体3D人姿势估计(HPE)仍然具有挑战性,因为深度模糊、隐含和时间一致性的必要性。 虽然多景方法比单景方法提供了更高的精度,但往往需要复杂的设置. 我们引入了STA-TFM,一种基于变压器的架构,将空间信息与时间信息相结合,用于多视图配置估计. 该方法利用DSTformer,一种单元特征提取器,来捕捉每个视图中的长距离寄托物. 然后,一个聚变器将各种观点的信息汇总起来,得出一致的三维估计。 为了解决培训数据稀缺的问题,我们使用一个数据生成管道,将任何现有的3D设置数据集转化为具有可控参数的多视图设置. 各种数据集的实验显示,STA-TFM的性能超过了现有的相机参数无多视图方法. STA-TFM在DHP19数据集上每联合位置错误(MPJPE)和每联合速度错误(MPJVE)的平均值分别实现50.9%和49.5%的降低. 此外,HAA4D的削减率分别达到6.7%和7.7%,MPJPE的削减率为15.2%。 STA-TFM处理噪音和缺失的2D输入,支持在保健监测、运动评估和浸润技术方面的潜在部署。 守则、训练检查站和数据见https://zenodo.org/records/22832620 。 。 。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Human pose estimation from video is a fundamental computer vision challenge with broad applications spanning healthcare and athletics [ 1 ] , virtual reality and gaming [ 2 ] , and beyond [ 3 , 4 ] , where developing accurate models holds significant promise. To obtain 3D estimates from videos, the task is often broken into two stages: 2D pose extraction followed by 2D to 3D lifting. While significant advancements have been made in 2D pose extraction from videos, obtaining 3D poses remains a complex problem [ 4 ] . Two methods have emerged to address lifting: monocular and multi-view human pose estimation (HPE), each with unique trade-offs between accuracy and accessibility. Monocular methods are more accessible as they rely on a single view, circumventing the need for complex and expensive data acquisition processes [ 5 ] . However, the single view results in an ill-posed problem in which a single 2D observation represents multiple 3D locations [ 6 ] . Depth ambiguity becomes more challenging in the presence of external and self-occlusions [ 5 ] . While monocular pose estimation is typically easier to deploy, it is often at the cost of accuracy. Without accurate 3D estimation, joint angles and movement patterns cannot be relied on to inform motion assessments. These challenges motivate the implementation of multi-view setups where 2D to 3D lifting relies on multiple cameras, making these models robust and better candidates for real-world applications. However, multi-view models often require complex and expensive setups for data acquisition, making them poor candidates for ‘in-the-wild’ scenarios and practical day-to-day monitoring [ 4 , 6 ] .
blocks.zh: 人类从视频中作出姿势估计是一项基本的计算机视觉挑战,其广泛的应用包括保健和运动[1]、虚拟现实和游戏[2],以及[3,4]之外,开发准确的模型具有重大前景。 为了从视频中获取3D估计,任务往往被分为两个阶段:2D姿势提取,然后2D升到3D升空. 虽然在2D中取得了显著进步, 已经出现了两种方法来解决抬升问题:单体和多视角的人类姿势估计(HPE),每种方法在准确性和无障碍性之间都有独特的权衡。 单体方法比较容易获得,因为它们依赖于单一的视角,绕过了复杂而昂贵的数据获取过程的需要[5]. 然而,单景导致一个不易出现的问题,即单2D观测代表多个3D位置[6]. 在存在外部和自我包容的情况下,深度模糊性变得更加具有挑战性[5]. 虽然单体姿势估计通常比较容易部署,但往往以准确性为代价。 没有准确的3D估计,联合角度和运动模式不能被依赖来为运动评估提供信息. 这些挑战促使实施多视图设置,其中2D至3D的提升依赖于多个相机,使这些模型成为现实世界应用的强健和更好的候选. 然而,多视角模型往往需要复杂和昂贵的数据采集设置,使它们成为 " 零星 " 情景和实际日常监测[4、6]的劣质候选人。

blocks.en: In monocular and multi-view methods, transformer-based architectures have gained traction in recent years for their ability to model long-range spatial and temporal dependencies [ 7 ] . Monocular models that harness spatial and temporal information demonstrate that attention mechanisms can improve temporal coherence and pose accuracy [ 8 , 9 ] . These benefits extend naturally to multi-view settings, where synchronized information from multiple cameras can be leveraged to obtain more robust 3D estimates. Existing methods exemplify this by fusing per-view spatial embeddings with a fusion pose transformer (FPT) to obtain reliable 3D poses from multiple 2D poses [ 10 ] .
blocks.zh: 在单景和多景方法中,基于变压器的架构近年来因其具有建模长距离空间和时间依赖性的能力而获得了牵引力[7]. 利用空间和时间信息的单体模型表明,关注机制可以提高时间一致性,并产生准确性[8,9]. 这些好处自然延伸至多视图设置,可以利用多个相机的同步信息获取更强的3D估计. 现有方法通过用聚变器(FPT)将每个视点的空间嵌入引信以获得来自多个2D的可靠的3D假体[10]来说明这一点.

blocks.en: Building on transformer-based multi-view methods, we introduce STA-TFM ( S patio- T emporal A ggregation Across Views T rans F or M er), a multi-view 3D human pose estimation framework that predicts 3D poses from multi-view sequences of 2D poses (see Figure 1 ). This framework is specifically optimized for applications where capturing accurate joint angles and relative body geometry is the primary objective. For each view, STA-TFM extracts spatio-temporal embeddings using DSTformer [ 8 ] , the feature extraction backbone of MotionBERT, originally designed for monocular pose estimation. These representations are then aggregated across views using a Fusion Pose Transformer (FPT) adapted from MPL [ 10 ] . This design is motivated by the fact that monocular pose models can leverage abundant single-camera datasets, which are considerably easier to collect and annotate than synchronized multi-view captures. We show that their learned spatio-temporal representations can be effectively reused in a multi-view setting.
blocks.zh: 基于变压器的多视图方法,我们引入了STA-TFM(S pario-T emporal A ggregation Over Views T runs F 或 M er),这是一个多视图的3D人形估计框架,它从2D的多视图序列中预测3D人形(见图1). 这个框架专门为应用优化,其中捕捉准确的关节角和相对体几何是主要目标. 对于每个视图,STA-TFM使用DSTformer[8]提取spatio-temporal嵌入,这是MotionBERT的特征提取骨干,最初是为单体姿势估计而设计的. 这些表述随后通过使用从MPL[10]改编的Fusion Pose变形器(FPT)来汇总各种观点. 这种设计的动机是单元化的姿势模型可以利用丰富的单相机数据集,这些数据集比同步的多视图捕获要容易得多,并且具有注释性. 我们显示,他们所学的时空表情可以在多视角环境中有效再利用。

blocks.en: To the best of our knowledge, STA-TFM is the first method to leverage a frozen pretrained monocular feature extractor (DSTFormer) for multi-view 3D HPE. By decoupling per-view feature extraction from cross-view fusion, the proposed architecture simplifies training and allows optimization to focus on multi-view aggregation and 3D pose regression. Combined with the proposed fusion strategy, STA-TFM achieves improved motion consistency and 3D pose accuracy in flexible-layout environments without requiring explicit geometric priors or camera parameters during training or inference. Furthermore, the results suggest that monocular spatio-temporal representations learned by DSTFormer remain effective when transferred to multi-view 3D human pose estimation.
blocks.zh: 就我们所知,STA-TFM是利用一个被冷冻的前置单体特性提取器(DSTFormer)用于多视图3D HPE的第一种方法. 通过从交叉视图聚变中脱钩的per-view特征提取,拟议的架构简化了培训,并允许优化以多视图聚合为重点,3D呈现回归. STA-TFM与拟议的聚变战略相结合,实现了运动一致性的提高,3D在弹性放电环境中呈现精确度,而无需在训练或推论中明确几何前缀或相机参数. 此外,这些结果表明,DSTFormer所学的单光谱时段表现在转入多视角3D人类估计时仍然有效。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Starting with multi-view videos, a 2D pose estimation model (e.g., RTMPose [ 11 ] ) extracts 2D joint locations from each camera view. These multi-view 2D poses are then processed by STA-TFM through spatio-temporal aggregation to predict the corresponding 3D pose. Only the videos are required; camera calibration parameters are not needed during inference. Example shown is from the BlendMimic dataset [ 12 ] .
blocks.zh: 图1:从多视图视频开始,一个2D表示估计模型(如RTMPose [11])从每个相机视图中提取2D联合位置. 这些多视图2D的外观随后由STA-TFM通过spatio-时态聚合处理,以预测相应的3D外观. 只需要视频;在推断时不需要相机校准参数. 显示的例子来自BlendMimic数据集 [12].

blocks.en: 2 Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en: Multi-view human pose estimation methods typically have higher accuracies as they effectively address the issues of depth ambiguity and occlusions prevalent with monocular HPE [ 10 , 4 ] . These models rely on multiple camera views, decreasing the chance of a fully occluded joint in all images. The information from additional views allows simple techniques, such as triangulation [ 13 ] , to be applied. Although triangulation is often the baseline for assessing multi-view setups, it is limited to cases where all keypoints are present and accurate [ 10 ] . Additionally, accurate camera extrinsic and intrinsic parameters need to be known beforehand.
blocks.zh: 多视角的人类姿势估计方法通常具有更高的敏度,因为它们有效地解决了普遍存在于单视HPE[10,4]的问题。 这些模型依赖于多个相机视图,减少了在所有图像中完全被占用的关节的机会. 来自额外观点的信息允许应用简单的技术,如三角化[13]. 虽然三角定位往往是评估多视图设置的基线,但仅限于所有关键点都存在且准确 [10]. 此外,必须事先知道准确的照相机外部和内在参数。

blocks.en: To address some of the limitations of triangulation, learning-based architectures have emerged. These methods can be broadly divided into camera-parameter methods, which require known camera intrinsics and extrinsic parameters, and camera-parameter-free methods, which do not.
blocks.zh: 为了解决三角化的一些局限性,出现了以学习为基础的建筑. 这些方法大致可分为摄像参数方法,需要已知的摄像内在参数和外在参数,以及没有摄像参数的方法,但并不需要.

blocks.en: 2.1 Camera-Parameter Methods
blocks.zh: 2.1 摄像头 方法

blocks.en:
Camera-parameter methods generally achieve higher accuracy than camera-parameter-free methods due to incorporating important prior knowledge into the network [ 14 , 15 ] .
Epipolar Transformers [ 16 ] exploit known camera parameters to identify corresponding epipolar lines across views, aggregating features from multiple cameras by attending to spatial locations along the epipolar line in one view using a joint query from another. Similarly, Transfusion [ 17 ] encodes 3D positional information into a transformer using an epipolar field, providing an efficient mechanism for encoding cross-view pixel correspondences.
blocks.zh:
相机参数方法一般比无相机参数方法的精度更高,因为将重要的以前的知识融入网络[14,15].
Epipolar Transformers [16] 利用已知的相机参数来辨别横跨视线的对应的极地线,通过使用来自另一视线的联合查询,在一视线上注意沿极地线的空间位置来汇总多个相机的特征. 同样,输[17]将3D位置信息编码成变压器,使用顶极场,为跨视像素通信编码提供了高效的机制.

blocks.en: Volumetric methods, such as VoxelPose [ 18 ] , project 2D joint heatmaps from all views into a shared 3D voxel space, using a Cuboid Proposal Network (CPN) to localize individuals and a Pose Regression Network (PRN) to estimate fine-grained 3D joint locations using 3D convolutional layers. SelfPose3D [ 19 ] extends the volumetric paradigm to a self-supervised setting, eliminating the need for 2D or 3D ground truth annotations by adopting a learning-by-projection paradigm, where the model learns 3D outputs by comparing projected 3D joint predictions against their 2D counterparts. While effective, volumetric approaches such as [ 18 , 19 ] incur significant computational cost [ 20 ] .
blocks.zh: VoxelPose[18],项目2D联合热映射从所有观点进入一个共享的3D voxel空间,使用Cuboid建议网络(CPN)将个人本地化,Pose递归网络(PRN)利用3D演化层估计精细的3D联合位置. SelfPose3D [19] 将量子学范式扩展至自我监督的设置,通过采用逐项学习的范式,消除了2D或3D地面真实说明的需要,模型通过比较预测的3D联合预测与其2D对应方来学习3D输出. 量法虽然有效,但如[18、19] 等方法的计算成本很高[20]。

blocks.en:
MVP [ 21 ] addresses some of those inefficiencies by directly regressing multi-person 3D poses from multi-view images without relying on 2D pose priors, representing skeleton joints as learnable query embeddings that
progressively attend to multi-view image features via a projective
attention mechanism. MVGFormer [ 22 ] takes a hybrid approach, combining a learning-free geometric module, which leverages triangulation to constrain the learning task, with a learnable appearance module for estimating 2D poses from images.
blocks.zh:
MVP [21] 解决一些低效问题,方法是在不依赖2D前缀的情况下,从多视图图像中直接递减多人 3D 的外观,代表骨架关节作为可学习的查询嵌入
通过投影程序逐步处理多视图图像特性
注意机制。 MVGFormer [22] 采用混合方法,结合一个无学习几何模块,利用三角化来约束学习任务,并配有一个可学习的外观模块,用于从图像中估计2D的外形.

blocks.en: TEMPO [ 20 ] further extends calibrated methods to the spatio-temporal domain using a recurrent architecture to jointly learn spatial and temporal representations across views, achieving state-of-the-art results and demonstrating the importance of incorporating both time and multi-view cameras.
blocks.zh: TEMPO [20] 进一步将校准方法扩展至时空域,利用一个经常性架构来共同学习跨观点的时空表达,实现最新结果,并展示结合时间和多视图相机的重要性.

blocks.en: 2.2 Camera-Parameter-Free Methods
blocks.zh: 2.2 照相机无孔照相机方法

blocks.en: Obtaining accurate camera parameters remains a significant hurdle in dynamic, uncontrolled settings [ 15 , 23 ] , limiting the practical deployment of camera-parameter methods. Therefore, various methods attempt to remove the need for known camera extrinsics to obtain 3D pose from multi-view set ups.
blocks.zh: 获取准确的相机参数仍然是动态和不受控制的设置[15,23]中的一大障碍,限制了相机参数方法的实际部署. 因此,各种方法试图消除对已知摄影机外观设备的需求,以便从多视图设置中获取3D姿势。

blocks.en:
Multi-view 3D Pose Lifter (MPL) [ 10 ] demonstrated strong performance for multi-view fusion, harnessing two transformers, a spatial pose transformer and a fusion pose transformer (FPT). MPL effectively extracts meaningful spatial features from each view and fuses the embeddings to capture spatial features across views.
Similarly, EFMK [ 24 ] combines Local-Global Pose Embedding with a Spatial-View Joint Transformer that integrates kinematic and geometric priors into attention computation. EFMK enforces bone length symmetry through a Bone-wise Alternating Optimization mechanism, and optionally refines predictions using reprojection-based multi-view aggregation when camera intrinsics are available.
However, both MPL and EFMK do not incorporate temporal information, which has been shown to improve accuracy and coherence of predicted 3D poses in both the monocular [ 8 ] and multi-view setting [ 20 ] .
blocks.zh:
多视3D Pose升降机(MPL)[10]在多视聚变方面表现出强大的性能,利用两个变压器,一个空间姿势变压器和一个聚变姿势变压器(FPT). MPL从每个视图中有效提取有意义的空间特征,并引信嵌入物,以捕捉不同视角的空间特征.
同样,EFMK [24]将本地-全球Pose嵌入与空间-维尤联合变形器结合,将运动前缀和几何前缀结合到注意力计算中. EFMK通过Bone-wise Alternative Optimation机制执行骨长对称,在有相机内含时,可选地利用重投影法的多视图聚合来改进预测.
然而,MPL和EFMK都没有包含时间信息,事实证明这可以提高预测的立体在单体[8]和多视图设置[20]中的准确性和一致性.

blocks.en: MTF-Transformer [ 15 ] addresses this by employing a Relative-Attention mechanism to measure implicit relationships between camera views using a Multi-view Fusing Transformer (MFT). This is followed by a Temporal Fusing Transformer (TFT) that aggregates features across the full sequence for final 3D pose prediction. However, this sequential spatial-then-temporal fusion restricts cross-domain communication between the two representations [ 14 ] .
blocks.zh: MTF-Transformer [15]通过使用相对留心机制,用多视图引信变形器(MFT)测量相机视图之间的隐含关系来解决这个问题. 接下来是TFT(TFT),它将各种特征组合到整个序列中,用于最终3D预测。 然而,这种相继的时空聚变限制了两种表示之间的跨域通信[14].

blocks.en: ESMformer [ 25 ] also leverages relative attention and performs hierarchical fusion across spatial, temporal, cross-view, and cross-level pose features. Given multi-view 2D pose sequences, it extracts multi-level spatial features per-view using a relative-attention-based encoder, performs multi-view intra-level fusion across views and time, and then applies cross-level fusion before regressing the final 3D pose. While its error-aware self-supervised training reduces reliance on 3D annotations by using triangulation and reprojection losses, these geometric constraints still require known camera parameters during training.
blocks.zh: 无害环境管理者[25]还利用相对的注意力,在空间、时间、交叉视野和跨层面的特征之间进行分级整合。 考虑到多视图2D的姿势序列,它利用基于相对意向的编码器来提取每个视图的多层次空间特征,在观点和时间之间进行多视图的平面内聚变,然后在倒退最终的3D姿势之前应用跨级聚变. 虽然其错误意识的自我监督训练通过使用三角化和再预测损失来减少对3D说明的依赖,但这些几何限制在训练期间仍然需要已知的相机参数.

blocks.en: Other methods such as [ 14 , 23 , 26 ] also incorporate spatio-temporal features for multi-view 3D human pose estimation. FusionFormer [ 14 ] encodes 2D HPE results into pose features, fuses them using a transformer encoder into a global spatio-temporal representation, and employs a transformer decoder that takes both global and view-specific features to estimate the 3D pose. FLEX [ 23 ] takes multi-view 2D poses as input and uses a deep convolutional network to learn 3D rotations and bone lengths rather than joint locations directly, incorporating cross-view attention and temporal information. SGRAFormer [ 26 ] employs a deep semantic graph transformer encoder to enrich spatial feature information by mining structural and skeletal edge knowledge of joints and their correlations. This is followed by a multi-view spatio-temporal fusion framework to mitigate joint depth uncertainty.
blocks.zh: 其他方法,如[14,23,26],也包含Spatio-时态特征,用于多视图的3D人类布局估计. FusionFormer [14]将2D HPE结果编码成布局特性,将它们用变压器编码成全球时空代表,并使用变压器解码器既采用全局特性又采用视点特性来估计3D的姿势. FLEX [23]采用多视图2D的姿势作为输入,并使用深演化网络来学习3D旋转和骨长,而不是直接连接位置,包含交叉视图关注和时间信息. SGRAFormer [26] 使用深语义图变形器编码器,通过挖掘关节及其关联的结构性和骨骼边缘知识来丰富空间特征信息. 之后是多视速报-时态聚变框架,以减轻联合深度不确定性.

blocks.en: Recent advancements have introduced an intermediate category that internally estimates camera geometry, eliminating the need for explicitly provided external camera parameters during inference. EasyRet3D [ 27 ] reconstructs human meshes independently from each view and uses Perspective-n-Point with RANSAC to initialize camera extrinsics from 3D-to-2D correspondences. Camera, body, and ground-plane parameters are then jointly refined. Qin et al. [ 28 ] instead predict camera intrinsics and extrinsics directly from multi-view features using a transformer-based architecture and use the estimated parameters for differentiable triangulation. Additional algebraic and temporal constraints are incorporated to improve pose quality. While both methods eliminate the need for externally supplied camera calibration during inference, they still rely on a camera-estimation stage with sufficient cross-view correspondence. Furthermore, EasyRet3D relies on heavy sequence-level test-time optimization that limits real-time utility.
blocks.zh: 最近的进步引入了一个中间类,内部估计相机几何,在推论时不再需要明确提供的外部相机参数. EasyRet3D [27] 从每个视图中独立重建人间网格,并与RANSAC使用Perspect-n-Point从3D到2D的通信中初始化相机外观. 相机、机体和地面飞机参数随后共同完善。 秦等编. [28] 相反,利用一个基于变压器的架构,直接从多视图特性预测相机的内在和外观,并使用估计参数来进行不同的三角. 增加了代数和时间限制,以提高质量。 虽然这两种方法在推论中都消除了外部提供的相机校准的需要,但它们仍然依赖于一个相机-估计阶段,并有足够的交叉视图通信. 还有,EasyRet3 D依赖于重序列级测试时间优化,从而限制了实时效用.

blocks.en: In contrast, STA-TFM directly regresses 3D poses from multi-view features without an intermediate camera parameter estimation step. STA-TFM takes multi-view 2D keypoints as input and feeds them to a frozen DSTformer [ 8 ] to extract per-view spatio-temporal features. These embeddings are then passed to a fusion network (FPT) inspired by MPL [ 10 ] to fuse cross-view features before a regression head produces the final 3D pose estimate.
blocks.zh: 相比之下,STA-TFM直接从多视图特性中递归3D,没有中间相机参数估计步骤. STA-TFM以多视图2D键点作为输入,并将其反馈到一个被冻结的DSTFormer [8] 以提取每个视图的spatio-时空特征. 然后将这些嵌入物传递给受MPL[10]启发的聚变网络(FPT),在回归头产生最终的3D姿势估计之前,将交叉视图特性引信.

blocks.en: In contrast to existing methods like MTF-Transformer and FusionFormer that train their entire spatio-temporal and multi-view fusion components end-to-end, STA-TFM leverages a pre-trained, frozen DSTformer feature extractor from monocular HPE. By keeping the DSTformer frozen, we inherit strong temporal modeling capabilities learnt from training on large-scale monocular datasets while focusing optimization exclusively on the fusion network and regression head for cross-view aggregation.
blocks.zh: 与诸如MTF-Transformer和FusionFormer训练其整个Spatio-tempor和多视聚变组件端到端等现有方法形成对比的是,STA-TFM利用了从单视HPE中预加训练,冷冻的DSTforce特性提取器. 通过保持DSTformer的冻结,我们继承了从大规模单体数据集培训中学习到的强大的时间建模能力,同时将优化的重点完全放在聚变网络和回归头上进行交叉视图汇总.

blocks.en: 3.1 Architecture
blocks.zh: 3.1 建筑

blocks.en: The lifting architecture involves two key steps to transform 2D poses into 3D representations: DSTformer and a Fusion Pose Transformer (FPT). As shown in Figure 2 , the keypoints obtained from a generic 2D pose estimator (e.g. RTMPose [ 11 ] ) are first passed to DSTformer to generate a motion representation, and a bottleneck layer is applied to compress the embedding before concatenating the embeddings from each view. The concatenated embedding is passed to a FPT to generate a fused embedding before the 3D pose is predicted by the final regression head.
blocks.zh: 升降架构涉及两个关键步骤,将2D所构成的3D表示器转换为DSTformer和一个Fusion Pose变形器(FPT). 如图2所示,从通用的2D型假构图(如RTMPose [11])中获取的键位首先传递给DSTformer,以生成运动表示,在从每个视图调和嵌入之前,应用瓶颈层来压缩嵌入. 在3D姿势被最终回归头所预测之前,凸起的嵌入会传递给一个FPT以生成一个引信嵌入.

blocks.en: DSTformer effectively captures the spatial and temporal information of the 2D skeleton within each view independently [ 8 ] . With DSTformer, an input skeleton, x ∈ ℝ T × J × C in \text{x}\in\mathbb{R}^{T\times J\times C_{\text{in}}} , with sequence length T T , J J joints, and input channel size, C in = 3 C_{\text{in}}=3 , ( x x , y y , c ​ o ​ n ​ f conf ), is first projected to a high dimensional feature space F 0 ∈ ℝ T × J × C f \text{F}^{0}\in\mathbb{R}^{T\times J\times C_{\text{f}}} and two learnable spatial and temporal positional encodings are added. Here, C f C_{\text{f}} is the number of high dimensional features. DSTformer takes F 0 \text{F}^{0} and passes it to the primary backbone. This backbone includes sequential blocks consisting of a dual stream of alternating temporal and spatial multi-head self-attention (MHSA) with skip connections. Spatial MHSA attends to the joint relationships within the skeleton, while temporal MHSA models the relationships of single joints over time. The streams are subsequently fused using adaptive weighting. The DSTformer backbone of dual stream alternating MHSA is repeated N N times ( N = 5 N=5 , obtained through hyperparameter tuning) to get F N ∈ ℝ T × J × C f \text{F}^{N}\in\mathbb{R}^{T\times J\times C_{\text{f}}} . A shared DSTformer backbone is applied independently to each camera view, producing one spatio-temporal embedding per view. These embeddings are compressed with a bottleneck layer before stacking the views E ∈ ℝ T × J × V × C b \text{E}\in\mathbb{R}^{T\times J\times V\times C_{\text{b}}} for the FPT, where V V is the number of views (default=4), and C b C_{\text{b}} is the bottleneck dimension.

blocks.en: The FPT architecture [ 10 ] aggregates multiple per-view pose features into a single latent representation capturing structural and temporal cues across cameras. Given the stacked embeddings of DSTformer, the joints and channels are flattened to obtain a compatible input E ∈ ℝ T × V × ( J ∗ C b ) \text{E}\in\mathbb{R}^{T\times V\times(J*C_{b})} , for the FPT. Learnable embeddings are added to the input to distinguish the cameras and provide positional context for each view. The fused tokens are then passed to a series of transformer blocks, each with MHSA that operates on the view dimension to learn inter-view relationships.

blocks.en: The fusion transformer incorporates mask-aware attention to selectively attenuate contributions from missing or low-confidence camera inputs during cross-view information aggregation. By applying view masks to the attention weights α i ​ j ∈ ℝ V × V \alpha_{ij}\in\mathbb{R}^{V\times V} during cross-view aggregation, the model prevents invalid tokens from influencing attention computation. In combination with stable attention normalization, the model preserves numerical stability and performance under heterogeneous or incomplete multi-camera inputs.

blocks.en: 3.2 Datasets
blocks.zh: 3.2 数据集

blocks.en: The DHP19 [ 30 ] , HAA4D [ 31 ] , BlendMimic3D [ 12 ] , CMUPanoptic [ 32 ] , and TotalCapture [ 29 ] datasets are selected to represent human-centric motion across diverse environments. Table 1 outlines the different datasets and their specific use in this work.
blocks.zh: DHP19 [30],HAA4D [31],BlendMimic3D [12],CMUPanoptic [32],和TotalCapture [29] 数据集被选为代表不同环境的以人为中心的运动. 表1概述了不同数据集及其在这项工作中的具体用途。

blocks.en: DHP19 and HAA4D are used to generate the training set for STA-TFM as described in Section 3.3 . DHP19 depicts standard human motion in controlled laboratory environments. It consists of 17 subjects performing 33 motions recorded using 4 orthogonal cameras with Vicon ground truth for 13 joints. Conversely, HAA4D [ 31 ] includes 3,390 samples and 300 action classes captured in uncontrolled environments. The videos are hand-labeled and processed using EvoSkeleton [ 33 ] to obtain 17 3D joint positions, providing diverse and dynamic motion scenarios.
blocks.zh: 如第3.3节所述,DHP19和HAA4D被用于为STA-TFM生成培训装置。 DHP19描绘了受控实验室环境中的标准人类运动. 它由17个主体组成,它们使用4个正交摄像头录制了33个运动,13个关节有维肯地面的真象。 相反,HAA4D[31]包括3,390个样本和300个在不受控制环境中捕获的动作类. 视频采用EvoSkeleton[33]手贴标签和处理,以获得17个3D联动位置,提供多样和动态的运动场景.

blocks.en: Additional datasets are also included to assess the peformance of STA-TFM and benchmark it against other methods. BlendMimic3D [ 12 ] is a synthetic animated dataset generated using Blender [ 34 ] , consisting of three subjects performing various actions in different scenes. Each scenario is captured from a four-camera convergent setup, with evaluation in this work restricted to scenario S1. CMUPanoptic [ 32 ] is a multi-view dataset providing synchronized video from five cameras that capture multiple subjects in dense, multi-person scenarios. Finally, TotalCapture [ 29 ] offers synchronized multi-view video, IMU data, and ground truth 3D poses captured by a Vicon motion capture system. In total, this dataset consists of 1.9M frames spanning multiple subjects and activities, designed for 3D pose estimation evaluation. Figure 3 illustrates the diverse camera configurations across these datasets.
blocks.zh: 还列入了其他数据集,以评估STA-TFM的合规性,并将其与其他方法相比较。 BlendMimic3D [12]是使用Blender [34]生成的合成动画数据集,由三个主体组成,在不同场景中进行各种动作. 每个场景都从一个四相机的集合设置中捕捉到,本作中的评价仅限于情景S1. CMUPanoptic [32]是一个多景数据集,提供五个摄像头的同步视频,在密集,多人的场景中捕捉到多个主题. 最后,TotalCapture [29] 提供了同步的多视图视频,IMU数据,以及被一个维孔运动捕捉系统捕获的地面真假3D假构. 这个数据集总共由1.9M框架组成,涵盖多个主题和活动,为3D设置了预测评价. 图3说明了这些数据集的各种相机配置。

blocks.en: STA-TFM is trained to predict zero-centered 3D skeletons centered at the root. Since the predicted skeletons are normalized and root-centered, they exist in a different coordinate frame than the ground truth, making direct comparison without alignment uninformative. Procrustes alignment is therefore applied to account for variations in translation, rotation, and uniform scaling between the predicted and ground truth skeletons. Importantly, Procrustes alignment does not modify the relative positions between joints or the overall skeleton shape, preserving inter-joint relationships and ensuring that the alignment step does not artificially inflate performance. This yields the primary evaluation metrics: P-MPJPE, P-PCK, and P-MPJVE. This approach is appropriate for applications such as movement assessment, joint angle estimation, and range of motion analysis, where accurate inter-joint relationships and body geometry are the primary objectives rather than absolute location in space.
blocks.zh: STA-TFM经过训练,可以预测以根部为中心的零中心3D骨架. 由于所预测的骨架是正常化的和以根为中心的,因此它们存在于一个与地面真理不同的坐标框中,进行直接比较,而无需对齐无信息. 因此,将Procrustes校正用于计算预测的真象骨架和地面真象骨架在翻译、旋转和统一缩放方面的变化。 重要的是,Procrustes 校正不会改变关节之间或整体骨架形状之间的相对位置,保持联合关系,并确保校正步骤不会人为地提高性能. 这得出了初级评价指标:P-MPJPE、P-PCK和P-MPJVE。 这种方法适用于运动评估,联合角度估计,运动分析范围等应用,其中准确的联动关系和体几何是主要目标而不是空间的绝对位置.

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: We evaluate STA-TFM across five datasets to assess its performance under different conditions. First, we evaluate the 2D-to-3D lifting capabilities of STA-TFM, examining the impact of temporal incorporation and composite loss function on datasets derived from DHP19 and HAA4D. Second, we assess generalizability to novel datasets using BlendMimic3D, which was not seen during training. We then benchmark STA-TFM against both camera-parameter and camera-parameter-free methods on two widely used benchmarks, CMUPanoptic and TotalCapture. To simulate real-world constraints, we further analyze the model’s performance under varying camera counts and 2D keypoint noise. We then examine the impact of temporal sequence length, concluding with a comparative analysis against leading monocular baselines. Finally, we present a qualitative assessment of STA-TFM to demonstrate its multi-view 3D pose reconstruction capabilities
blocks.zh: 我们通过五个数据集评估STA-TFM,以评估它在不同条件下的表现. 首先,我们评价STA-TFM的2D-3D升空能力,审查时间整合和复合损失功能对DHP19和HAA4D数据组的影响。 第二,我们评估使用BlendMimic3D的新数据集的通用性,这在训练期间是看不到的. 然后,我们将STA-TFM作为基准,参照两个广泛使用的基准,即CMUPanoptic和TotalCapture,使用摄像头参数和无摄像头参数方法。 为了模拟现实世界的限制,我们进一步分析模型在各种相机计数和2D键点噪声下的表现. 然后,我们审查时间序列长度的影响,最后对照主要单一基线进行比较分析。 最后,我们介绍了对STA-TFM的质量评估,以展示其多视角3D的重建能力

blocks.en: 4.1 Impact of Temporal Modeling
blocks.zh: 4.1 临时模拟的影响

blocks.en: To quantify the performance gains of incorporating temporal information into pose embeddings, STA-TFM is compared against vanilla MPL [ 10 ] , which lacks temporal information. Table 2 presents the performance comparison between these methods. To ensure a fair comparison, both methods are trained on the same dataset generated from HAA4D and DHP19, for the same number of epochs. For all experiments, predictions utilize four 2D skeletons sequences captured at approximately 90-degree intervals with varying distances from the subject. Each 2D skeleton is normalized and zero-centered around the root before processing. Since MPL lacks temporal integration, relying solely on spatial features, STA-TFM’s improvement over the vanilla model is expected. Therefore, to establish a fair baseline, a naive Savitzky-Golay temporal filter is applied post-hoc to MPL’s predictions.
blocks.zh: 为了量化将时间信息纳入嵌入模型的性能收益,STA-TFM与缺乏时间信息的香草MPL[10]进行比较. 表2列出了这些方法之间的业绩比较。 为确保进行公平的比较,两种方法都接受了HAA4D和DHP19生成的相同数据集的培训,对象为相同数量的时代。 在所有实验中,预测都利用了四个2D骨架序列,它们间隔大约90度,距离主体不同。 每个2D骨架在处理前都会在根周围正常化,零中心化. 由于MPL缺乏时间整合,仅依靠空间特征,预计STA-TFM会比香草模型有所改进. 因此,为了建立一个公平的基线,一个天真的萨维茨基-戈莱时间过滤器被应用到MPL的预测中.

blocks.en: Table 2 shows that STA-TFM significantly outperforms vanilla MPL on both DHP19 and HAA4D datasets. Even when a Savitzky-Golay temporal filter is applied post-hoc to MPL’s predictions, improvements remain marginal and inconsistent across datasets, suggesting that a learned approach to temporal modeling is more effective than naive post-processing.
blocks.zh: 表2显示,STA-TFM在DHP19和HAA4D数据集上的香草MPL的性能明显高于. 即使将Savitzky-Golay时间滤波器用于MPL的预测后,改进仍然微不足道,而且各数据集之间不一致,这表明对时间建模学识的方法比天真后处理更有效.

blocks.en: On DHP19, STA-TFM achieves 50.9% and 49.5% reductions in P-MPJPE and P-MPJVE, respectively, compared to MPL, with similar improvements of 6.7% and 7.7% on HAA4D. These gains in spatial accuracy and temporal coherence are directly attributed to incorporating temporal information, which provides an inherent denoising effect by considering multiple time points.
blocks.zh: 在DHP19上,STA-TFM在P-MPJPE和P-MPJVE中分别实现了50.9%和49.5%的削减,而MPL中,HAA4D的类似改进率为6.7%和7.7%。 空间精确度和时间一致性方面的这些进步直接归因于纳入时间信息,这通过考虑多个时间点提供了内在的去诺效应.

blocks.en: The performance variation between datasets can be attributed to several key factors. First, the training data distribution contains a natural imbalance, with DHP19 comprising approximately 80% of the training frames. Second, the datasets employ different splitting strategies: DHP19 uses subject-based splits that maintain action diversity during training, while HAA4D employs action-based splits that require generalization to unseen motion patterns. HAA4D also presents additional challenges through its more diverse and dynamic actions and unconstrained environments.
blocks.zh: 数据集之间的性能差异可归因于几个关键因素. 第一,培训数据分布自然不平衡,DHP19约占培训框架的80%。 其次,数据集采用不同的分割策略:DHP19使用在训练中保持动作多样性的基于主题的分割,而HAA4D则使用基于动作的分割,需要泛化到看不见的运动模式. HAA4D还通过其更加多样和活跃的行动和不受限制的环境,提出了额外的挑战.

blocks.en: Despite these challenging conditions in HAA4D, the temporal modeling in STA-TFM still provides improvements over MPL, demonstrating the value of integrating temporal information even for novel actions.
blocks.zh: 尽管在HAA4D中存在这些挑战性的条件,STA-TFM中的时间建模仍然比MPL有所改进,证明了即使对于新颖的行动,整合时间信息的价值.

blocks.en: 4.2 Impact of Loss Function
blocks.zh: 4.2 损失函数的影响

blocks.en: MPJPE is the primary loss function typically used in 3D HPE model training. However, this loss function does not penalize 3D HPE predictions with low temporal consistency (jittery predictions). Therefore, STA-TFM improves temporal consistency by utilizing a composite loss, ℒ composite \mathcal{L}_{\text{composite}} , as described in Section 3.4 . To assess the impact of the composite loss, two versions of STA-TFM are trained: one with a standard loss based solely on MPJPE and another with ℒ composite \mathcal{L}_{\text{composite}} . Both models are trained on DHP19 + HAA4D, and results are reported on each dataset separately in Table 2 .
blocks.zh: MPJPE是3D HPE模型培训中常用的主要损失功能. 然而,这种损失函数并不惩罚时间一致性低的3D HPE预测(急切预测). 因此,STA-TFM通过使用综合损失(L complex \ mathcal{L}_{\Text{composite})来提高时间一致性,如节所述. 3.4 (英语). 为了评估复合损失的影响,训练了两个版本的STA-TFM:一个是完全基于MPJPE的标准损失,另一个是L复合型\mathcal{L}_{\text{composite}. 两个模型都经过了DHP19 + HAA4D的培训,结果在表2中分别汇报。

blocks.en: The results in Table 2 demonstrate a clear improvement when using ℒ composite \mathcal{L}_{\text{composite}} on both DHP19 and HAA4D datasets. Specifically, STA-TFM achieves 41.0% and 2.3% reductions in P-MPJVE on DHP19 and HAA4D, respectively. An improvement in P-MPJPE is also observed, with reductions of 6.2% and 5.0% on DHP19 and HAA4D, respectively. This spatial accuracy improvement can be attributed to ℒ composite \mathcal{L}_{\text{composite}} encouraging temporally consistent poses, which reduces frame-to-frame jitter and consequently improves per-frame predictions. The varying impact of ℒ composite \mathcal{L}_{\text{composite}} on P-MPJVE between datasets reflects their inherent differences, as described in Section 4.1 .
blocks.zh: 表2的结果表明,在DHP19和HAA4D数据集上使用L complex \ mathcal{L}_{\text{composite}明显改进。 具体而言,STA-TFM在DHP19和HAA4D的P-MPJVE中分别实现了41.0%和2.3%。 还观察到P-MPJPE有所改进,DHP19和HAA4D分别减少了6.2%和5.0%。 这种空间精度的提高可归因于L complex \ mathcal{L}_{\text{composite}鼓励时间上一致的姿势,这降低了帧对帧的紧张度,从而改善了每个帧的预测. L complex \ mathcal{L}_{\text{composite}在数据集之间对P-MPJVE的不同影响反映了它们固有的差异,如第4.1节所述.

blocks.en: 4.3 Generalization to Unseen Datasets
blocks.zh: 4.3 通用到不明数据集

blocks.en: To assess generalizability to unseen datasets, STA-TFM and MPL are trained on DHP19 and HAA4D datasets and evaluated on BlendMimic3D, which features new motion patterns and unfamiliar camera placements and configurations. As shown in Table 2 , STA-TFM substantially outperforms MPL across all metrics, achieving 70.8% and 41.6% reductions in P-MPJPE and P-MPJVE, respectively. These improvements stem from STA-TFM’s ability to use pretrained DSTformer backbone, which provides transferable spatio-temporal representations that enhance generalization to unseen data. Since DSTFormer is adapted from monocular human pose estimation, it benefits from training on monocular datasets that are more abundant than multi-view datasets, contributing to improved generalization across diverse scenarios.
blocks.zh: 为了评估不可见数据集的通用性,STA-TFM和MPL接受了DHP19和HAA4D数据集的培训,并在BlendMimic3D上进行了评价,该数据集具有新的运动模式和不熟悉的相机布置和配置. 如表2所示,STA-TFM在所有指标中都大大超过MPL,P-MPJPE和P-MPJVE分别实现了70.8%和41.6%的削减。 这些改进来自STA-TFM使用预先训练的DSTformer骨干的能力,它提供了可转移的时空表示,可以增强通俗化到看不见的数据. 由于DSTFormer是从单体人姿势估计中调整出来的,因此它得益于对单体数据集的培训,这些数据集比多视图数据集更丰富,有助于改进对不同情景的概括。

blocks.en: 4.4 Performance Against Camera-Parameter-Free Methods
blocks.zh: 4.4 对抗无相机光圈方法的性能

blocks.en: To evaluate STA-TFM against existing camera-parameter-free methods, we use the TotalCapture dataset following the training and testing split of [ 15 ] . The evaluation protocol tests generalization across four scenarios defined by combinations of seen and unseen cameras and subjects. In all scenarios, the test samples are novel and were not included in the training set. Specifically: (1) seen cameras and seen subjects, where both the camera setup and subjects appeared in the training set but are performing different actions; (2) seen cameras and unseen subjects, where the camera setup was seen during training but the subjects are novel; (3) unseen cameras and seen subjects, where the subjects appeared in training but the camera configuration is novel; and (4) unseen cameras and unseen subjects, where both the camera setup and subjects are novel to the model.
blocks.zh: 为了对照现有的无相机参数方法评价STA-TFM,我们使用在[15]的训练和测试分拆后的总Capture数据集. 评估协议对四种情景的概括性进行了测试,这些情景是由被看到和看不见的照相机和主题的组合确定的。 在所有情景中,测试样本都是新颖的,没有列入培训集。 具体来说: (1)看到相机和所见主体,相机设置和主体都出现在训练场中,但进行不同的动作; (2)看到相机和所见主体,在训练场中看到相机设置,但主体是新颖的; (3)看不见相机和所见主体,在训练场中出现,但相机配置是新颖的; (4)看不见相机和所见主体,相机设置和主体对模型都是新颖的.

blocks.en:
While various comparable camera-parameter-free methods report results on TotalCapture [ 15 , 14 , 10 , 26 , 24 ] , many do not release their code bases, preventing direct comparison. We therefore limit our comparison to methods with publicly accessible code bases. Among these, none provide TotalCapture-specific model weights or evaluation code, requiring us to retrain all baselines on identical dataset splits using the hyperparameters specified in their original papers. The training set consists of 2D keypoints obtained from RTMPose [ 11 ] paired with their corresponding 3D ground truth skeletons, introducing realistic 2D keypoint predictor noise into the training and evaluation.
Results are reported in Table 3 . P-MPJPE is reported as the primary evaluation metric for all methods, ensuring that differences in alignment protocols are accounted for to provide a balanced comparison. Under this standard, STA-TFM achieves highly competitive results when looking at the mean of both seen and unseen subjects and camera setups, achieving 15.2%, 35.7%, 40.8%, 50.2%, and 55.22% reductions in P-MPJPE compared to MPL [ 10 ] , SGraFormer [ 26 ] , MTF-Transformer [ 15 ] , EFMK [ 24 ] , and ESMFormer [ 25 ] , respectively. As expected, all methods experience a performance drop when evaluated on unseen subjects or cameras.
blocks.zh:
虽然各种可比较的无相机参数方法报告了总容量[15,14,10,26,24]的结果,但许多方法并没有发布它们的代码基础,防止了直接比较. 因此,我们仅限于将方法与可公开查阅的代码基数进行比较。 其中,无一提供TotalCapture特有模型权重或评价代码,要求我们使用原始论文中指定的超参数,在相同的数据集分割上重新调整所有基线. 训练集包括从RTMPose[11]获得的2D关键点与其相应的3D地面真人骨架对齐,将现实的2D关键点预测器噪声引入训练和评价中.
调查结果见表3。 P-MPJPE被报告为所有方法的主要评价衡量标准,确保调整协议的差异得到考虑,以便进行均衡的比较。 根据这项标准,STA-TFM在观察所见和未见的科目和相机设置的平均值时,取得了高度竞争的结果,与MPL[10]、SGraFormer[26]、MTF-Transformer[15]、EFMK[24]和ESMFormer[25]相比,P-MPJPE分别实现了15.2%、35.7%、40.8%、50.2%和55.22%的削减。 如所料,所有方法在对隐形主题或摄像头进行评价时都会出现性能下降。

blocks.en: 4.5 Performance Against Camera-Parameter Methods
blocks.zh: 4.5 对相机-相机的性能 方法

blocks.en:
CMUPanoptic is a popular benchmark for evaluating camera-parameter methods. While these baseline models provide a valuable performance ceiling across the broader literature, they are not directly comparable to camera-parameter-free approaches. This is because they operate in a different problem space by relying on known camera
parameters as geometric priors, allowing them to operate in absolute world space. On the other hand, STA-TFM functions as a camera-parameter-free method, focusing on capturing accurate body geometry in normalized space. Consequently, the evaluation metrics differ: calibrated models report absolute MPJPE, while normalized outputs require Procrustes aligned MPJPE (P-MPJPE).
blocks.zh:
CMUPanoptic是评价照相机参数方法的流行基准. 虽然这些基线模型在更广泛的文献中提供了宝贵的性能上限,但它们并不直接比照无摄像机参数方法。 这是因为它们依靠已知的相机在不同的问题空间运行
参数作为几何前缀,允许它们在绝对世界空间中运行。 另一方面,STA-TFM作为无相机参数的方法发挥作用,专注于在正态空间中捕捉准确的体几何. 因此,评价指标不同:校准模型报告MPJPE的绝对值,而规范输出则需要Procrustes对齐的MPJPE(P-MPJPE).

blocks.en: To contextualize the performance of STA-TFM against these models, both STA-TFM and MPL are trained on CMUPanoptic following the training and testing split of VoxelPose [ 18 ] . We include MPL, the most architecturally comparable camera-parameter-free method to STA-TFM, as a reference point for comparison. Training is performed using 2D keypoints from RTMPose [ 11 ] paired with their corresponding 3D ground truth skeletons.
blocks.zh: 为了将STA-TFM的性能与这些模型进行上下文化,STA-TFM和MPL在VoxelPose[18]的培训和测试分解后都接受了CMUPanoptic的培训. 我们包括了MPL,这是与STA-TFM最具有建筑可比性的无相机参数法,作为比较的参考点. 培训使用来自RTMPose [11] 的2D键位与其相应的3D地面真人骨架对齐进行。

blocks.en: CMUPanoptic contains multi-person scenarios, but STA-TFM like all other comparable camera-parameter-free methods [ 10 , 26 , 15 , 24 ] supports only single-person inference. To handle this, we implemented a pre-processing step where 2D keypoints from all camera views were cross-associated to identify and group keypoints belonging to the same person, isolating individual subjects before passing them to the models for inference.
blocks.zh: CMUPanoptic包含多人情景,但STA-TFM与其他所有可比的相机参数无误方法[10,26,15,24]一样,只支持单人推论. 为了解决这个问题,我们采取了一个预处理步骤,将所有相机视图中的2D键点交叉连接,以识别和组合属于同一人的键点,孤立单个对象,然后将其传递给模型进行推论.

blocks.en: Table 4 presents STA-TFM and MPL against several camera-parameter methods. Despite the advantage of using Procrustes alignment, as expected, camera-parameter methods achieve higher accuracy than camera-parameter-free methods due to incorporating geometric priors [ 14 , 15 ] . Nevertheless, STA-TFM outperforms MPL ( ↓ \downarrow 16.5% P-MPJPE, ↑ \uparrow 1.12% PCK, ↓ \downarrow 41.65% MPJVE). To further benchmark STA-TFM against traditional non-learning camera-parameter methods, the framework is also evaluated against a classical linear triangulation baseline, with full methodological details and comparative results provided in A.1.1 .
blocks.zh: 表4列出了STA-TFM和MPL对照几种相机参数的方法。 尽管如预期的那样使用Procrustes对齐的优点,但相机参数方法由于包含了几何前缀[14,15],因此其精度高于无相机参数方法. 尽管如此,STA-TFM的表现还是超过了MPL(QQ\下游16.5%P-MPJPE,QX\上游1.12%PCK,XX\下游41.65%MPJVE). 为了进一步参照传统的非学习摄影参数方法对STA-TFM进行基准评估,还参照经典的线性三角基线对框架进行评估,在A.1.1中提供了完整的方法细节和比较结果。

blocks.en: 4.6 Impact of Fine-Tuning DSTFormer
blocks.zh: 4.6 Fine-Tuning DST Former的影响

blocks.en:
To assess whether fine-tuning DSTFormer yields additional performance gains for STA-TFM, we compare frozen and unfrozen variants trained for 50 epochs on
CMUPanoptic with identical hyperparameters. Table 5 shows that unfrozen training yields negligible improvements (MPJPE: 30.17 → 30.26 30.17\rightarrow 30.26 mm with RTMPose keypoints, 28.83 → 28.29 28.83\rightarrow 28.29 mm with GT keypoints), demonstrating that monocular spatio-temporal features transfer effectively to multi-view 3D HPE without the need for task-specific fine-tuning.

blocks.en: 4.7 Impact of Number of Cameras in Multi-View Methods
blocks.zh: 4.7 多维方法照相机数量的影响

blocks.en: STA-TFM requires a minimum of two distinct camera views to predict 3D keypoints from a given set of 2D keypoints. Ideally, these cameras should be radially positioned for optimal performance (see Figure 5 a). To assess the impact of the number of views on 3D keypoint prediction accuracy, Table 6 reports STA-TFM performance relative to the number of cameras. Starting from a 4-camera setup, we simulate reduced coverage by removing cameras using two strategies: consecutive dropout, where the last m m consecutive cameras ( ∼ \sim 90 ∘ apart) are removed, and random dropout, where m m cameras are randomly dropped regardless of their position. Figure 5 b demonstrates both dropout strategies.
blocks.zh: STA-TFM需要至少两个截然不同的相机视图,才能从一个给定的一组2D键点预测3D键点. 理想的情况是,这些摄像头应进行辐射定位,以达到最佳性能(见图5a)。 为了评估观点数量对3D关键点预测准确性的影响,表6相对相机数量报告了STA-TFM的性能. 从四摄像头的设置开始,我们模拟缩小覆盖范围,方法是使用两种策略去除相机:连续的退出,其中去掉最后的米连续相机(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\ 图5b显示了两种辍学战略。

blocks.en: Table 6 shows that performance decreases with fewer cameras, with the four-camera setup providing the lowest error rates. The results also reveal that camera order significantly impacts accuracy: consecutive camera dropout yields better performance than random dropout. This can be attributed to the learnable positional embeddings in the fusion transformer, which encode the spatial relationships between views. When cameras are dropped consecutively, the remaining views maintain their expected positional context. However, random dropout disrupts these learned spatial relationships, leading to degraded performance.

The model demonstrates reasonable tolerance to keypoint dropout, maintaining stable performance when up to five keypoints are randomly occluded per frame (P-MPJPE increases from 17.56 → \rightarrow 23.83 mm), which covers typical occlusion scenarios in real-world capture.
For Gaussian noise, the model shows minimal degradation at 1% of subject height (P-MPJPE: 18.28 mm), a noise level representative of modern 2D pose detectors like RTMPose. At 5% noise, performance degrades substantially (P-MPJPE: 54.88 mm, P-MPJVE: 52.18 mm/frame), indicating that the model is sensitive to the larger positional uncertainties characteristic of low-quality 2D detections. This behavior is expected for camera-parameter-free methods, which lack the geometric constraints available to calibrated approaches and must rely more heavily on input quality.

blocks.en: 4.9 Impact of Sequence Length
blocks.zh: 4.9 序列长度的影响

blocks.en: As DSTFormer [ 8 ] was originally pretrained using 243-frame windows, an ablation was performed to evaluate the effects of temporal window length when applied to datasets with variable sequence lengths. HAA4D contains short clips with an average length of 64 frames, while DHP19 contains substantially longer recordings, averaging 2110 frames. To accommodate shorter sequences, STA-TFM was trained with reduced window lengths, 81, 54, and 36 frames, while window strides remained a third of the sequence length. Table 8 shows that DHP19 performance remains almost similar across window lengths, with a decrease in P-MPJPE ( ↓ 3.78 ​ mm \downarrow 3.78\text{mm} ) but an increase in P-MPJVE ( ↑ 0.09 ​ mm/frame \uparrow 0.09\text{mm/frame} ) when reducing the window length from 81 frames to 36 frames. This indicates that the model can effectively extract motion cues from temporal segments of multiple lengths.
blocks.zh: 由于 DSTFormer [8] 最初是使用243帧窗口进行预训的,因此在应用到具有可变序列长度的数据集时,进行了对时间窗口长度效果的评价. HAA4D包含短片段,平均长度为64帧,而DHP19包含的录音量大得多,平均2110帧. 为了适应更短的序列,STA-TFM接受了窗口长度缩短,81,54和36帧的训练,而窗口的脚步仍然是序列长度的三分之一. 表8显示,DHP19跨窗口长度的性能仍然几乎相似,在将窗口长度从81帧缩小到36帧时,P-MPJPE(XQ 3.78 mm\ downarrow 3.78\text{mm})减少,但P-MPJVE(XX 0.09 mm/frame\uparrow 0.09\text{mm/frame})增加. 这表明模型可以有效地从多个长度的时间段提取运动提示.

blocks.en: The primary performance benefit was seen with the short HAA4D videos as shown in Table 8 . When windowed at 36 frames, the P-MPJPE ( ↓ 11.97 ​ mm \downarrow 11.97\text{mm} ) and P-MPJVE ( ↓ 2.5 ​ mm/frame \downarrow 2.5\text{mm/frame} ) decreased significantly in comparison to a temporal length of 81. This improvement arises as shorter windows better match HAA4D’s intrinsic clip duration and reduce the influence of padding. These findings demonstrate that compact temporal windows can effectively capture motion in brief videos without compromising performance in long-duration videos.

blocks.en: 4.10 Multi-View vs. Single-View Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.10 多视频与单视频分析

blocks.en: To contextualize STA-TFM performance relative to monocular approaches, we compare against popular single-camera 3D HPE models: MotionBERT [ 8 ] , RTMW3D [ 38 ] , VideoPose3D [ 37 ] , and BlazePose (MediaPipe) [ 39 ] . Multi-view methods inherently benefit from reduced depth ambiguity and improved occlusion handling compared to monocular approaches. We quantify this advantage in this analysis. These models are selected because they incorporate temporal information across multiple frames to predict 3D poses, ensuring a fair comparison. Since STA-TFM utilizes the DSTformer block from MotionBERT to generate spatially and temporally aware 2D pose embeddings, the comparison with MotionBERT is particularly relevant, as any performance gains can be directly attributed to multi-view fusion via the FPT block. Comparisons with other models are provided for completeness. To ensure fairness, STA-TFM is provided with 2D keypoints computed by running RTMPose [ 11 ] on videos from the four camera views in BlendMimic3D.
blocks.zh: 为了将STA-TFM的性能与单光学方法相对比,我们比较了流行的单相机3D HPE模型:MotionBERT [8],RTMW3D [38],VideoPose3D [37],和BlazePose (MediaPipe) [39]. 与单体方法相比,减少深度模糊和改进隔离处理,对多视角方法具有内在好处。 我们在分析中量化这一优势。 这些模型之所以被选中,是因为它们包含跨越多个框架的时间信息,以预测三维面,确保公平比较. 由于STA-TFM利用来自MotionBERT的DSTformer块生成空间和时间意识2D的嵌入,因此与MotionBERT的比较特别相关,因为任何性能增益都可以直接归因于通过FPT块的多视图聚变. 为完整性提供了与其他模型的比较。 为确保公平,STA-TFM通过在BlendMimic3D的四个相机视图的视频上运行RTMpose[11]来计算2D键点.

blocks.en: Table 9 shows that STA-TFM achieves substantially better performance compared to the best monocular model (VideoPose3D): P-MPJPE ( ↓ 11.6 % \downarrow 11.6\% ), P-PCK ( + 44.72 % +44.72\% ), and P-MPJVE ( ↓ 57.1 % \downarrow 57.1\% ). Similar improvements are observed compared to MotionBERT: P-MPJPE ( ↓ 20.9 % \downarrow 20.9\% ), P-PCK ( + 47.12 % +47.12\% ), and P-MPJVE ( ↓ 61.4 % \downarrow 61.4\% ). As expected, this performance advantage decreases with fewer cameras, as shown in the 3-camera and 2-camera configurations in Table 9 . Notably, when constrained to a two-camera configuration, STA-TFM does not outperform the leading monocular model in terms of P-MPJPE; however, it consistently outperforms monocular models in P-PCK and P-MPJVE. This suggests that even limited cross-view aggregation provides a regularizing effect on temporal jitter, enabling smoother and more anatomically consistent 3D motions than single-camera architectures can produce. These results demonstrate that multi-view information provides more accurate 3D poses compared to monocular approaches, which suffer from depth ambiguity and occlusions.

blocks.en: 4.11 Qualitative Assessment
blocks.zh: 4.11 定性评估

blocks.en: Qualitative results of STA-TFM under challenging conditions are presented in Figure 8 . The associated full video sequences are provided in the supplementary material showing multi-view 3D pose reconstruction for subjects S1, S2, and S3 performing acting and freestyle sequences on the TotalCapture dataset.
blocks.zh: 图8列出了STA-TFM在困难条件下的质量结果。 相关的完整视频序列在补充材料中提供,显示在TotalCapture数据集上为主题S1,S2和S3进行多视图3D配置重建的动作和自由式序列.

blocks.en: Notably, when subjects move out of view and the 2D detector hallucinates non-human artifacts as keypoints, STA-TFM maintains reasonable 3D pose reconstruction (Figure 8 (a)). Furthermore, the model demonstrates tolerance to occluded joints in single views and successfully reconstructs poses from remaining cameras when one or more views contain missing keypoints (Figure 8 (b)). This behaviour is attributed to the integration of keypoint confidence scores into the DSTFormer feature embeddings, which down-weights unreliable detections. Additionally, the model’s predictions are less sensitive to scale and translation, as training on root-centered and height-normalized skeletons removes these dependencies.
blocks.zh: 值得注意的是,当主体离开视线,2D探测器将非人类文物幻觉作为关键点时,STA-TFM保持合理的3D配置重建(图8(a)). 此外,当一个或多个观点包含缺失的键点时,该模型表现出对单视中隐蔽关节的容忍度,并成功从余下相机中重建外形(图8(b))。 这种行为归因于将关键点置信分数整合到DSTFormer特性嵌入中,使重量降低不可靠的检测. 此外,模型的预测对规模和翻译不太敏感,因为以根为中心的和高度正常化骨架的培训消除了这些依赖性。

( a ) Noisy input 2D keypoints when subjects are partially visible or completely absent from camera views. ( b ) 3D pose reconstruction from remaining camera views when one or more views are missing or contain incomplete 2D keypoint detections. ( c ) Noise in predicted 3D keypoints at the extremities, particularly at wrists and arms, compared to stable core body keypoints. ( d ) Noise in predicted 3D keypoints during extreme movements in freestyle scenarios where rapid motion challenges temporal modeling.

blocks.en: Despite these strengths, an increase in noise is observed in the extremities, particularly at the wrists and elbows. As these distal joints typically exhibit higher velocities and larger ranges of motion, they challenge temporal consistency, while core body keypoints remain comparatively stable (Figure 8 (c)). Beyond these localized inaccuracies, the model exhibits broader failure cases in extreme scenarios. In the event the majority of camera views lack valid 2D keypoints, the model performance degrades significantly. Complex self-occlusions, particularly in the TotalCapture freestyle scenario, where participants perform rapid atypical movements such as tucking into a ball and jumping, challenge the model’s accuracy (Figure 8 (d)). These cases highlight the limitations of temporal modeling under highly dynamic motion patterns.
blocks.zh: 尽管有这些长处,在极点,特别是在手腕和肘部,噪音有所增加。 由于这些分散的关节通常表现出更高的速度和更大的运动范围,因此对时间一致性构成挑战,而核心的机体关键点则保持相对稳定(图8(c))。 除了这些局部不准确的情况外,模型还显示出在极端情况下更广泛的失败案例。 如果大多数相机视图缺乏有效的2D键位,模型性能会显著退化. 复杂的自我包容,特别是在TotalCapture freetyle情景中,参与者进行快速的非典型运动,如套入球和跳跃,挑战模型的准确性(图8(d))。 这些案例凸显出在高度动态运动模式下时间建模的局限性.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: This paper presents STA-TFM, a multi-view spatio-temporal transformer for 3D human pose estimation that integrates DSTformer for temporal modeling with a fusion transformer for cross-view aggregation. Unlike traditional approaches that depend on known camera calibration parameters, STA-TFM learns to aggregate multi-view 2D poses to directly predict 3D body poses. This makes STA-TFM more practical for real-world deployments where calibration data may be unavailable or unreliable.
blocks.zh: 本文介绍STA-TFM,是用于3D人类的多视图时空变压器,用于时间模型的DSTformer与聚变变器集成,用于交叉视图聚合. 与依赖已知的相机校准参数的传统方法不同,STA-TFM学习聚合多视图2D的姿势来直接预测3D体的姿势. 这使得STA-TFM在校准数据可能不可用或不可靠的现实世界部署中更加实用.

blocks.en:
Extensive experiments show that STA-TFM outperforms comparable camera-parameter-free methods. On DHP19, STA-TFM achieves 50.9% and 49.5% reductions in P-MPJPE and P-MPJVE compared to MPL, with improvements of 6.7% and 7.7% on HAA4D. On TotalCapture, STA-TFM outperforms all compared camera-parameter-free methods, achieving
15.2%, 35.7%, 40.8%, 50.2%, and 55.22% reductions in P-MPJPE compared to MPL [ 10 ] , SGraFormer [ 26 ] , MTF-Transformer [ 15 ] , EFMK [ 24 ] , and ESMFormer [ 25 ] , respectively. The composite loss function ℒ composite \mathcal{L}_{\text{composite}} is shown to enhance temporal consistency, yielding 41.0% and 2.3% additional P-MPJVE reductions on DHP19 and HAA4D, respectively, compared to a standard loss function solely based on MPJPE. Qualitative and quantitative results demonstrate tolerance to missing views and noisy keypoints.
blocks.zh:
广泛的实验表明,STA-TFM优于可比的无相机参数方法. 在DHP19上,STA-TFM实现了P-MPJPE和P-MPJVE的50.9%和49.5%的削减,HAA4D的改进率为6.7%和7.7%。 在TotalCapture上,STA-TFM在比照无相机参数方法的操作上都胜过,实现了
与MPL[10]、SGraFormer[26]、MTF-Transformer[15]、EFMK[24]和ESMFormer[25]相比,P-MPJPE分别减少了15.2%、35.7%、40.8%、50.2%和55.22%。 综合损失函数 L complex { mathcal{L}_{\text{composite} 显示可以增强时间一致性,与完全基于MPJPE的标准损失函数相比,DHP19和HAA4D分别产生41.0%和2.3%的P-MPJVE额外减少. 定性和定量结果表明对缺失的观点和吵闹的关键点持宽容态度。

blocks.en:
To the best of our knowledge, STA-TFM is the first method to leverage frozen pre-trained monocular features (DSTformer) for multi-view 3D HPE.
The limited gains observed from fine-tuning DSTFormer (Section 4.6 ) suggest that spatio-temporal representations learned for monocular pose estimation data remain effective when transferred to multi-view 3D human pose estimation.
To address training data scarcity, a data generation pipeline is utilized that simulates n n radially distributed cameras with controllable noise parameters, enabling training without expensive multi-camera setups.
blocks.zh:
据我们所知,STA-TFM是第一个为多视图3D HPE利用被冷冻的前置单体特性(DSTformer)的方法.
从微调DSTFormer(第4.6节)中观察到的有限收益表明,在向多视点3D人姿势估计转移时,为单视点所学的时空表示仍然有效。
为了解决培训数据短缺的问题,利用了一个数据生成管道,以可控制噪音参数模拟nn辐射分布式摄像机,使培训无需昂贵的多摄像机设置。

blocks.en: STA-TFM has several limitations. First, the model requires synchronized inputs, which increases computational cost with additional cameras. Second, while STA-TFM operates without explicit geometric priors at inference, the model learns from a specific radial distribution during training; consequently, it operates optimally with similar setups. Furthermore, like other camera-parameter-free methods, STA-TFM supports only single-person inference. In multi-person scenarios, it requires per-person multi-view keypoints, necessitating keypoint association across views before inference, adding an additional step. Lastly, STA-TFM outputs normalized, root-centered 3D poses, and Procrustes alignment with ground truth is needed to obtain poses in the world frame of reference. This means that while the predicted poses maintain accurate relative joint positions and can be used to measure body angles and skeletal proportions, they cannot be used to measure real-world distances between joints or track the subject’s overall travel distance.
blocks.zh: STA-TFM有几种限制. 首先,该模型需要同步输入,通过增加摄像头来增加计算成本. 第二,虽然STA-TFM在操作时没有明确的几何前缀推断,但模型在训练期间从特定的射线分布中学习;因此,它的运作与类似的设置是最佳的. 此外,与其他无相机参数方法一样,STA-TFM只支持单人推论. 在多人假设中,它需要每人的多视图关键点,在推论前需要将不同观点的关键点关联起来,从而增加一个额外的步骤. 最后,STA-TFM产出实现正常化,以根为中心的3D形式,需要与地面真理保持一致,才能在世界参照框架内获得面孔。 这意味着,虽然预测的姿势保持了相对的关节位置,并可用于测量身体角度和骨骼比例,但是它们不能用来测量关节之间的现实世界距离或跟踪主体的整体旅行距离.

blocks.en: The practical implications of STA-TFM extend across domains where flexible, low-cost motion capture is needed. By only requiring radially distributed cameras with no calibration, STA-TFM enables deployment in environments where traditional motion capture is impractical. In clinical settings, clinicians could capture high-quality 3D pose estimates using low cost smartphones on tripods for quantitative assessment of neuromotor tasks, rehabilitation exercises, and movement disorders. This capability opens the door to generating large, matched datasets of videos and 3D poses for patients performing clinical assessments, data that is currently scarce and expensive to collect. Similar setups could support athletic performance analysis and sports medicine, making 3D pose estimation accessible to practitioners in gyms, on fields, and in rehabilitation facilities.
blocks.zh: STA-TFM的实际影响涉及需要灵活、低成本的运动捕捉的领域。 STA-TFM仅要求无校准的射线分布相机,就可以在传统运动捕捉不切实际的环境中部署. 在临床环境下,临床医生可以使用三脚架上的低成本智能手机获取高质量的立体模型估计,对神经运动任务、康复练习和运动障碍进行定量评估。 这一能力为产生大型、匹配的视频数据集和用于进行临床评估的病人的3D姿势打开了大门,这些数据目前很少,而且收集起来昂贵。 类似的设施可以支持体育表演分析和运动医学,使健身房、田野和康复设施中的从业人员能够利用3D技术进行估计。

blocks.en: Although a performance gap remains relative to camera-parameter methods that leverage geometric priors, STA-TFM narrows this gap without requiring camera calibration. Closing the remaining gap would benefit from exploring world-frame pose representations to eliminate the need for Procrustes alignment, extending the fusion mechanism to multi-person scenarios, and optimizing for real-time inference. Establishing standardized benchmarks for camera-parameter-free multi-view HPE would also accelerate progress by enabling fair cross-method comparison across the field.
blocks.zh: 尽管与利用几何前兆的相机参数方法相比,性能差距仍然存在,但STA-TFM在不需要相机校准的情况下缩小了这一差距. 探索世界范围的表述,消除对普罗克鲁斯特结构的调整,将聚变机制扩大到多人方案,优化实时推论,将有利于缩小剩余差距。 为无相机参数的多视图高频设备制定标准化基准,也将通过使整个外地能够进行公平的跨方法比较而加快进展。

blocks.en:
To assess the impact of using a 2D keypoint detector on the 2D-to-3D lifting process, STA-TFM is evaluated on videos from the BlendMimic3D dataset using 2D keypoints predicted by RTMPose [ 11 ] .
This setup reflects a realistic inference scenario in which the 2D inputs contain inherent detection noise from a 2D HPE model. The resulting 3D poses are compared against linear triangulation [ 13 ] , which estimates 3D keypoints from multi-view 2D observations and corresponding camera parameters. Experiments are conducted across 2-, 3-, and 4-view configurations, as summarized in Table 10 .
blocks.zh:
为了评估使用2D键点探测器对2D至3D升空过程的影响,STA-TFM在BlendMimic3D数据集的视频上通过使用RTMpose预测的2D键点进行评价[11].
这种设置反映了一种现实的推论情景,即2D输入中包含2D HPE模型中固有的检测噪声. 由此得出的3D面值与线性三角化[13]相比较,线性三角化从多视图2D观测和相应的相机参数中估算出3D键点. 如表10所示,在2、3和4视图配置方面进行了实验。

blocks.en: Triangulation provides a meaningful baseline only when 2D poses are obtained from a keypoint detector rather than ground truth annotations. Under synthetic conditions with perfect camera parameters, triangulation gains an unrealistic advantage because ground truth 2D keypoints together with exact camera parameters allow near deterministic recovery of the original 3D pose when subjects are fully visible and unoccluded across views [ 13 ] . Although triangulation still benefits from the ideal camera parameters provided in the BlendMimic3D dataset, noise introduced by 2D keypoint detection results in a more realistic and informative performance benchmark.
blocks.zh: 只有在从一个关键点探测器而不是地面真实说明中获取2D姿势时,三角法才提供了有意义的基线. 在具有完美相机参数的合成条件下,三角化获得了不切实际的优势,因为地面真理2D键点与精确的相机参数一起,可以在主体完全可见且横跨视界时,对原有的3D姿势进行近乎确定性的恢复[13]. 虽然三角测量仍然得益于BlendMimic3D数据集中提供的理想相机参数,但2D键点检测引入的噪声使得性能基准更加现实,信息更加丰富.

blocks.en: As shown in Table 10 , the P-MPJPE obtained with ground truth 2D poses is 34.2% lower than that obtained using the RTMPose-predicted 2D keypoints. The increase in P-MPJPE can be attributed to the propagation of errors from the 2D pose detector to the subsequent 3D lifting process. Despite this degradation, STA-TFM consistently outperforms triangulation across all camera configurations in terms of P-PCK and P-MPJVE. Notably, STA-TFM with three cameras achieves lower MPJPE than triangulation with four, reducing setup cost and complexity. STA-TFM also enforces greater temporal coherence and reduces jitter, as demonstrated by lower P-MPJVE values. This highlights STA-TFM’s robustness and generalization when relying solely on noisy 2D detections without requiring camera calibration.
blocks.zh: 如表10所示,通过地面真理2D形式获得的P-MPJPE比使用RTMPose预测的2D键位得到的P-MPJPE低34.2%。 P-MPJPE的增加可归因于从2D摆设探测器传播到随后的3D提升过程的错误. 尽管出现这种退化,STA-TFM在P-PCK和P-MPJVE方面,在所有相机配置上始终超越三角化. 值得注意的是,配有三台相机的STA-TFM实现的MPJPE低于配有四台的三角化,降低了设置成本和复杂性. STA-TFM还执行更大的时间一致性和减少焦躁,低P-MPJVE值就证明了这一点. 这凸显了STA-TFM在完全依靠吵闹的2D探测而不需要照相机校准时的坚固性和通俗性.
